acquisition.host_conditions: Shared host; other project activity was reported. Recorded before/after load averages do not establish isolation or thermal control.

scope: Nine CPU eager/indexed region-search workloads, all native observations using tight_support. The changed implementations combine scheduling, packed region/knowledge storage and work-lease size; this comparison does not isolate a mechanism.
native_work_limits: No expansion-work override; other unexposed native limits are those of each recorded executable.

statistics.median: Integer midpoint of the two middle observations; each cell has four timed samples and two separate RSS samples per block. Blocks remain separate.
statistics.phase_times: Timed observations preserve all recorded driver/stage/phase timing fields. Parallel phase totals may overlap and exceed wall time.
statistics.outcome_rows: Every requested position is retained. Only timed rows carry wall_ns and timing; only memory rows carry memory. Reference profile is null.
statistics.unix_timestamps: Decimal nanoseconds are strings to avoid precision loss in JSON consumers.

retention.published: All requested slot decisions, selected-model counts and costs; every native timed wall/driver/stage/phase observation and separate RSS observation; profiles, limits and source/executable identities.
retention.omitted: Raw stdout/stderr, command paths, temporary materialization paths, process identifiers, inode/device identifiers, and untimed qualification/warmup durations.
retention.semantic_limit: Numeric summaries can be recomputed here. Complete family equality requires original captures or a new acquisition. These report-time input observations are not an atomic executable lease.
